name: Harama Santa no Nakadashi Merry Christmas!!
original_name: 孕まサンタの中出しメリークリスマス!!
source:
~*~*~*~*~*~*~
It was the night before Christmas,
All the world was at peace /
But in spite of the season
Some girls could not be pleased. /
"I'll fix them!" said Santa
With a nudge of his c*ck. /
And he gave them a present
As naughty as f**k.
~*~*~*~*~*~*~ 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE070964.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
~*~*~*~*~*~*~
那是圣诞节前一天晚上，
全世界都太平了 /
但尽管是季节
有些女孩高兴不起来。/
“我会解决它们的！”圣诞老人说
随着他的阴茎轻轻一推。/
他给了他们一份礼物
和他妈一样顽皮。
~*~*~*~*~*~*~
